fact: The Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Act 2026, signed 18 February 2026, lets the minister designate critical infrastructure (s.26), requires owners to report any cybersecurity incident to the authority within 24 hours (s.30), and requires the National Communication Authority to establish the SS-CIRT/CC (s.32).
title: EXPLAINER: Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Act 2026: Chapter V
